title: Do not reference hidden or reserved state in any emitted model prompt
purpose: Live model seats must never be given other parties' private state, psychic/hidden observations, engine/RNG state or SECRET/INTERNAL fields; doing so leaks evidence the actor was not entitled to.
trigger: Prompt/payload assembly code refers by name to a reserved hidden-state field or SECRET/INTERNAL holder (for example a psychic/hidden-state or other-agent-private ledger) that the boundary contract does not admit for the acting viewer.
correct: Route all live prompt fields through the provenance-labelled envelope that admits only public state plus the acting party's own private field, and fail closed on anything else before provider invocation.
evidence_note: psychic-poker prompt-boundary audit v0.7.38 admits only public table state plus the acting player's own hole-card field; other-player private state and SECRET/INTERNAL material are fail-closed.
